subject: Reprovision Penpot MCP 2.13.3 with transport fix
body: Rebuild the local Penpot MCP runtime from current setup-penpot-mcp.sh. This version patches the upstream shared-McpServer transport reuse bug and rebuilds packages/server. Return complete success/failure evidence including DORE_PENPOT_TRANSPORT_PATCH_PASS. Do not alter Doré model configuration.
